question: Find the surname of the driver who set the fastest qualifying time (Q2) at the circuit in Austria that hosted the Austrian Grand Prix most recently.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_039" AS surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q."XCL_057" = r."XCL_065"
JOIN circuits c ON r."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
JOIN drivers d ON q."XCL_058" = d."XCL_034"
WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Austria'
  AND r."XCL_069" = 'Austrian Grand Prix'
  AND r."XCL_066" = (
    SELECT MAX(r2."XCL_066")
    FROM races r2
    JOIN circuits c2 ON r2."XCL_068" = c2."XCL_001"
    WHERE c2."XCL_005" = 'Austria'
      AND r2."XCL_069" = 'Austrian Grand Prix'
  )
  AND q."XCL_063" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (
  CAST(SUBSTRING(q."XCL_063", 1, INSTR(q."XCL_063", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
  + CAST(SUBSTRING(q."XCL_063", INSTR(q."XCL_063", ':') + 1, INSTR(q."XCL_063", '.') - INSTR(q."XCL_063", ':') - 1) AS REAL)
  + CAST(SUBSTRING(q."XCL_063", INSTR(q."XCL_063", '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000
) ASC
LIMIT 1
